Wires egradx-audit and egradx-auth to each other: records made in a request name the signed-in person, and the organization they are in; the audit endpoints check the caller's egradx-auth authorities, which live in egradx-auth's catalog — every organization's Admin reads its own trail, and reading all of them is reserved to the platform organization; records show people's and organizations' names, looked up as they are read. egradx-auth's own events — sign-ins, password changes, role edits — need nothing from here: it publishes them, and egradx-audit stores them.
